It assumes AC and the exact hypotheses of alg-metropolis-hastings-kernel, proves its output is a probability kernel with symmetric target flow, then invokes reversibility-implies-invariance. The local theorem applies the same result to the fixed-epsilon augmented probability target on Theta x Y and the stated simulator proposal. No mixing or convergence claim is imported.

Read the current Definition. For finite nonnegative weights it normalizes them (with a uniform fallback only if all vanish), specifies the multinomial categorical count law, and returns exactly N ancestor indices/counts. The ABC-SMC algorithm calls only the multinomial branch on a positive normalized previous weight vector; if an ABC incremental-weight total vanishes it stops before any subsequent resampling.

Read the complete current Statement and proof. For either resampling scheme and N>=1, conditional expected counts are N times normalized weights, including the zero-input uniform convention. The local proof uses this identity for its multinomial ancestor draw and for the conditional empirical-mean identity after weighting. The count theorem is finite and choice-free.
